results.overview: A cash-strapped young couple inherits a grand country house, only to find it is both falling apart and teeming with the ghosts of former inhabitants.
results.name: Ghosts

results.overview: There’s something strange happening in Morgan City, Louisiana and Travel Channel’s latest paranormal team is ready to get to the bottom of it.
results.name: Ghosts of Morgan City

results.overview: The ambulance doctor Alexey Ivanov once suffered a severe trauma - his beloved classmate was strangled right on the prom night, and the memory of this terrible incident continues to haunt him everywhere. Returning briefly on business to his small homeland, to a quiet provincial town, Alexey becomes the main suspect in a crime that he did not commit, and now he is forced to lead the search for the maniac himself – as it turned out, all these years he continued to crack down on girls, and attacks happened only during those periods when Alexey was in the city.
results.name: Ghosts of the Past

results.overview: Based on the novel of the same name by Anna Knyazeva. The comfortable, orderly life of a Zamoskvoretsky VIP atelier is shattered overnight. Its owner, Nadezhda Raukh, finds herself embroiled in a mysterious incident: an important client's briefcase disappears from the fitting room, followed by her disappearance. Due to confidentiality, security officer Lev Astrakhansky investigates the incident. Accusing Nadezhda of all mortal sins, he soon discovers that the crime has historical ramifications…
results.name: Ghosts of Zamoskvorechye
